entry.name: mc.separate~
entry.description: The mc.separate~ object splits a multichannel signal into two or more multichannel signals with specific channel counts.

arguments.name: channels per outlet
arguments.description: Each argument tocreates an outlet whose output multichannel signal will contain the number of channels specified by that argument. If no arguments are present, two oulets will be generated; the left outlet will have a multichannel signal with two channels. Any remaining channels from the input will be contained in the right outlet's multichannel signal.

outlets.description: Multichannel signal output fromcontains a copy of the input multichannel signal divided according to the channel count arguments. The left outlet has a channel count specified by the first argument; subsequent outlets will have the remaining channels. The right outlet will have any leftover channels from the input multichannel signal.
